protocol.judge_prompt: candidate-isolated v7 Korean feedback-quality pointwise rubric; source-score blind; five fixed prompt types with ten seed repeats each; vLLM json_schema with post-decode fail-closed validation

axis_feedback_quality_rubric.content: Evaluate whether the feedback accurately diagnoses idea relevance, adequacy, specificity, or development from the essay; cites valid support; and gives an actionable content-improvement step.
axis_feedback_quality_rubric.organization: Evaluate whether the feedback accurately diagnoses structure, sequence, paragraph linkage, coherence, or cohesion from the essay; cites valid support; and gives an actionable organization-improvement step.
axis_feedback_quality_rubric.expression: Evaluate whether the feedback accurately diagnoses clarity, wording, grammar, sentence construction, or style from the essay; cites valid support; and gives an actionable expression-improvement step.

prompt_types.review_emphasis: Use a conservative evidence-audit pass: verify every cited sentence ID before evaluating the diagnosis.
Prioritize whether each diagnosis is entailed by the cited wording or by a clearly verifiable absence in the essay.
Give equal weight to whether each next step is concrete, feasible, and follows from its diagnosis.
Check that content, organization, and expression claims remain within their stated axis rather than borrowing unsupported claims from another axis.

Also assess whether the feedback reads as clear, internally consistent, natural Korean with a logical diagnosis-to-next-step flow; this lowers quality when weak but does not by itself trigger abstention.

protocol.train_scoring: score observations only; may not use validation observations
protocol.validation_scoring: frozen evaluation-only; may not influence train selection, prompt choice, SFT, DPO, or GRPO
